title: Chapter 2: Ada Town
_comment: Chapter 2 reformulated (2026-09-15) as Ada Town - a dirt-and-grass village, not a stone ruin. Tileset switched to dirt_grass.json with scattered organic grass patches (seed 24001) blob-autotiled over a dirt-dominant base, matching the tileset's own "worn village courtyard" description. Structurally: a little forest at the entrance (Ada Woods, cols 2-26), THE BRANCHING MAZE ITSELF is the town (cols 28-150, full height) - its walls are houses/fences/market stalls/wells instead of ruined pillars, its corridors are the town's own streets and alleys - and the guarded vault past it (cols 152-165) is unchanged in mechanic (three fragments, any order, raise the gate) from the prior Buried Court version, just re-flavored as the town's old counting-house vault. Same underlying quest/companion (Vigil, dark_knight) and hostile roster (skeleton/skeleton_archer/ghoul/mummy - an abandoned town overrun by the dead is exactly as coherent a read as an abandoned ruin was) - this is a re-theming of the setting, not a redesign of the chapter's mechanics.
